name: socially
description: Read public social profiles and posts, search topics and usernames, and follow lookup jobs.

interface.longDescription: Read public social profiles and posts, see what people are publishing about a topic, and follow username or email lookup jobs. socially reports what it found and what it could not check separately. Missing data stays missing: a blocked page is not proof that a profile does not exist. It does not sign into social accounts or read private messages.
capabilities: Search videos, news and country trends
Search usernames and follow lookup jobs
Read web pages and their link previews
defaultPrompt: Read the public profile at this link.
What videos and news were published about urban gardening this week?
What is the status of my lookup job?
